review_candidates.title: Senior Planning Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: This role is responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining production and project plans that support operational efficiency and timely delivery of services. Qualifications: Strong Planning and Production Planning skills to develop, optimize, and monitor operational and project schedules.
eligibility_evidence: Role Description The Senior Planning Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, Egypt.
Ability to work on-site in Cairo, Egypt, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Qualifications: Strong Planning and Production Planning skills to develop, optimize, and monitor operational and project schedules. Proficiency with planning and scheduling tools (e.g., MS Project, Primavera, or similar) and MS Excel.
